sections.en: 6 ἀνεπιφανῆ ('unapparent') the codex has, corrected by Kroll. 8 τι μέσον ('some middle') is suspect. 9 εἰς ('into') I have inserted. 14 ἀσωτίαν ('profligacy') conjectured by Kroll. Namely εἰς γυναῖκα ἄσωτον ('into a profligate woman') compare for example Aristaenetus epistle II, 12 τὴν ἄσωτον ὑπαινίττομαι ('I hint at the profligate woman') * [Wünsch]. 16 lacuna indicated. 17 αὐτὸν ('him') the codex has. 23 after ἑαυτὸν ('himself') I have indicated a lacuna. 24 ὁ ('the') I have inserted. 26 θλιβεῖται ('is afflicted') the codex has.

summary.headline: Runaway and Serapion’s Katarchai
summary.text: Astrological rules for finding a runaway, using the Moon’s position, planetary aspects, houses, pivots, travel direction, and the midheaven to predict discovery, loss, escape, or the master’s death. Begins “On katarchai of Serapion,” outlining how to judge beginnings by the hour lord and planets on the pivots.
